responsibility: This file implements GCC’s late RTL instruction reorganization passes for delay-slot architectures and target-specific machine reorg hooks. Its main responsibility is delay slot scheduling after register allocation and final jump optimization: identifying fillable slots, moving or duplicating safe insns from before/after/branch targets, relaxing resulting control-flow patterns, updating resource and label information, and collecting scheduling statistics. It also defines the separate machine_reorg pass wrapper that invokes targetm.machine_dependent_reorg for backend-specific late instruction restructuring.
